rationale: The original short thesis relied on tight consolidation below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($155.96) for an immediate breakdown, but price has instead made consecutive higher lows and higher highs on the 1-minute bars to reclaim the 9-EMA and reach $156.19, one cent below invalidation.
